storage.notes: microSD up to 128GB; cloud storage not supported (fully local).

No IR/white LEDs (anti-glare) - full-color night vision from ambient light

blue_iris.notes: Add as ONVIF/RTSP camera using the OpenEdge-provided stream URL.
